This child is 18 months old. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child has cough or difficult breathing. The cough has lasted 3 days. The child does not have diarrhoea, ear problem, or fever. I counted the breaths for one full minute and the respiratory rate before bronchodilator was 45. The child was calm during the assessment. Chest indrawing was not present. Wheezing was observed and there was no stridor when the child was calm. Pulse oximeter was not available. Bronchodilator trial was completed. After bronchodilator, I counted the breaths again for one full minute, and the respiratory rate was 35. The child was calm after the bronchodilator and there was no chest indrawing. Recurrent wheeze was not found.

No identified bacterial cause is present. The child did not have measles within the last 3 months and there is no measles cough. The child does not have red eyes, runny nose, or stiff neck.
